title: Can't See Cpvp
body:
This mod blacks out crystal PvP related visuals by turning affected items and elements completely black. It is designed for players who want a cleaner or more minimal combat appearance without changing gameplay mechanics.

Features
Blacks out crystal PvP related items and visuals
Simple lightweight visual modification
Works automatically once enabled
Minimal performance impact
Notes
This is a cosmetic/visual-only modification
Does not provide gameplay advantages or automation
Intended for custom visual preference and reduced visual clutter
